title: Shortness of breath at 34 weeks
presenting_complaint: Sudden shortness of breath and right-sided pleuritic chest pain for 3 hours at 34 weeks of pregnancy.
history: G2P1, 34 weeks pregnant, uncomplicated pregnancy. Symptoms began while walking upstairs. No haemoptysis, no fever, no calf pain or leg swelling. 9-hour flight five days ago. No previous VTE, no known thrombophilia, non-smoker. Medications: prenatal vitamins only.

findings.name: General
findings.value: Alert, anxious, speaking in short sentences

findings.name: Legs
findings.value: No oedema, calves soft and non-tender

findings.name: ECG
findings.value: Sinus tachycardia 118/min, S1Q3T3, T-wave inversion V1-V3

findings.name: Bedside echo
findings.value: Dilated right ventricle, normal LV function

findings.name: CTPA
findings.value: Filling defects in right lower lobe segmental arteries

management_options.label: Oxygen to keep SpO2 at 94% or above
Urgent obstetric review and fetal monitoring
Systemic thrombolysis
management_options.explanation: Not indicated in a haemodynamically stable patient.
